contentPattern.structure: collapsible question/answer pairs; each row = [ question | answer ]

suitableFor: compacting a list of headings with hidden detail bodies
notSuitableFor: content that should be fully visible without user interaction

usage.note: Created for the WKND FAQs page (7 collapsible Q&A items). Based on the Block Collection accordion block but made DA-compatible: removed the moveInstrumentation/scripts.js import (imports nothing beyond native DOM APIs), all classes renamed to the accordion-faq-* namespace. Renders native <details>/<summary> so it works without JS and is accessible by default.
